description: Defines the Role entity class for user administration, including properties, permissions management, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Entity class representing user roles with permissions, supporting creation, updates, and permission checks.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Role instance from a JSON command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates role properties based on JSON command input.

methods.name: updatePermission
methods.description: Adds or removes a permission based on selection status.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission to the role.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from the role.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with the role.

methods.name: hasPermissionTo
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specific permission by code.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the role to a data transfer object.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the role is disabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the role is enabled.
